narrative_note: Subarea covers most of Gävleborg county except for Nordanstig, Hofors, and Sandviken. To the west the area extends into Dalarna county where parts of Orsa and Rättvik municipalities are part of the Hälsingenät structure. Ellevio owns both regional and local grid and holds the area concession for nearly the entire subarea. The subarea has substantial production connected relative to local consumption. Other municipalities in the subarea (the remaining Gävleborg county municipalities such as Bollnäs, Hudiksvall, Ovanåker, Ockelbo) are not explicitly listed in the source.
